notes.title: MOMIJI FROM PURGATORY Discount / Update (New Discount on 2021/09/27)
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello everyone, the MOMIJI FROM PURGATORY main program has been officially launched on 2021/06/22 , Chinese or English language can be selected in the setting , and the first-person perspective is used during the game.

Introduction : Player will operate a college teenager,dating and sex with a nice body female classmate,and then fall in love with another female classmate who had a pure personality and also had sex,the story of our game will start after the revealed cheat incident,a series of horror plans for love were launched.[/b][/h3]

[h1]Discount history : [/h1]
[h3][b]Discount time: 2021/06/22~2021/06/29[/b][/h3]
While celebrating the arrival of 2021, the new discount will be released on January 1, 2021, and the discount includes four indie games (three on Steam and one on Google Play) from the beginning of 2019 to the end of 2020. , The discount will last for two weeks. Interested players can also choose the package type below.
[h3][b]Discount time: 2021/09/18~2021/10/02[/b][/h3]
The annual Mid-Autumn Festival holiday is coming soon, and all indie games sold on Steam in the past will be released with a half-price discount (for a period of two weeks)





[h1]Repair bug history : [/h1]
[b][h3]Hello, everyone, the follow-up update and error repair messages will be concentrated here, because some programs may be changed from time to time, new problems may arise. Once there is a problem, it will take another time to repair. Sorry for the inconvenience![/h3][/b]
